<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
additive_causal_mask(seq_len: int) -> np.ndarray
```

Part of [`evoxc_hf.reference`](/api/evoxc-hf/reference/)

Causal additive mask of shape `(seq_len, seq_len)` in float32.

Entry `(i, j)` is `0.0` when key position `j <= i` (the query may
attend to itself and the past) and `MASK_NEG` when `j > i` (strictly
future).  Adding it to the attention scores is the HF convention; the
resulting softmax weight for a future key is *exactly* `0.0` in f32.

## Parameters

- `seq_len` · `int` — Sequence length (integer >= 0).

## Returns

- `np.ndarray` — `(seq_len, seq_len)` float32 array; a `(0, 0)` array for `seq_len == 0`.

## Raises

- `TypeError` — If `seq_len` is not integer-like.

- `ValueError` — If `seq_len` is negative.
